description: Controlled experiment spec for Nemotron vs Claude vs DeepSeek vs Qwen in OpenCode + Unreal MCP

constants.ue_rule: one editor instance; enable monolith only when port 9316 has single listener

models.notes: Primary Nemotron candidate; do not use NIM until smoke pass
OpenRouter only; NIM hangs in OpenCode #34026
Or direct DeepSeek API if configured
Watch for empty tool name loops #33618 on Plus/Max variants

tasks.prompt: Using Monolith blueprint_query, read BP_BattleUI's OnKeyDown graph wiring. Report lane-to-key bindings as JSON. Read-only; do not mutate.

Wire a call site for RestorePartyAfterBattle on BP_MelodiaJRPGGameMode. Follow Monolith Recipe 15: export_graph, fingerprint before, compile, assert_graph_matches, save. Stop on not clean or matched:false.
Find all callers of HandleQuillNotification in C++ and Blueprint. Trace paths that reach it from QuillScript notification dispatch. Report as structured list.
Export DA_MelodiaIntegrationConfig CDO properties via Monolith get_cdo_properties. List TravelLevelIds. Cross-check each ID against AGENTS.md allowlist section. Report discrepancies only.
Run: python Tools/bp_sweep.py --scope Content/MelodiaIntegration/Blueprints (or documented scoped flag). Summarize defect classes found in one paragraph. Quote tool output; do not invent findings.
Three-step on a named Blueprint property: locate asset, read property via Monolith, set new value, re-read to verify. Owner must name target property before run.
